assemblyRules: Exact-coordinate endpoint stitching of complete Overpass member geometries; no invented closure.
Member role outer forms shells; inner rings assigned to the smallest containing outer ring. Member order/direction does not determine role.
Source topology must pass GEOS validity before clipping. No buffer(0), make_valid, simplification, estimated river width or geometric repair is applied.
True polygon intersection with the requested bbox retains holes and can split disconnected parts. Outer rings CCW, inner rings CW.
Selected-relation outer way duplicates are suppressed. Named/unnamed water features remain separate in water-source-features.geojson for provenance.
water.geojson is a true topological union of accepted source features: overlapping coplanar surfaces are eliminated while main-Han island holes remain dry. No buffer or simplification.
OSM contributor usernames, user IDs, changesets and unrelated tags are not included in public outputs.
limits: Current OSM community mapping, not hydrographic survey, live waterline, flood model, measured elevation or guaranteed complete feature inventory.
GeoJSON carries plan shape only. Terrain/water elevations, triangle-cell clipping and visual layering belong to runtime integration.
The raw Overpass response is retained privately for reproducibility and contains public OSM edit metadata. Publish only this minimized provenance and GeoJSON.
Clipped boundary vertices are calculated intersections; underlying banks and islands remain the unsimplified source geometry.
